files.docs/decisions/0003-storage.md:
# 0003 — Shared state storage

Date: 2026-02-20
Status: accepted

## Context

Two or more agents claim tasks concurrently and need receipts for messages.

## Decision

Use Postgres for shared state. Code and docs stay in git.

## Alternatives considered

- SQLite only, synced through git: rejected because claims need atomic updates across
  machines and git merges cannot provide them.
- A hosted document store: rejected for cost and vendor lock-in.

criteria: Every claim in the Claims section names the fixture file it comes from

## Claims

- Decision: Postgres for shared state; code and docs stay in git (docs/decisions/0003-storage.md)
- Rejected: SQLite only synced through git, because claims need atomic updates across machines (docs/decisions/0003-storage.md)
- Rejected: a hosted document store, for cost and vendor lock-in (docs/decisions/0003-storage.md)

## Uncertainty

- The ADR names no Postgres version or hosting. Confidence: high.
